title: 応用数学
subtitle: Applied Mathematics
keywords: Vector space 2.Linear mapping 3.Linearly independence 4.Base and Dimension 5.Eigenvalue and eigenvector
educationalGoal: The object of this course is to acquire the mathematical knowledge of linear algebra.Students will:(1)learne basic mathematics to analyze dynamic systems of the aeronautical engineering.(2)learne basic mathematics to perform CFD analysis for the aeronautical engineering.(3)acquire basic knowledge and logical thinking skills for control systems.
advice: This is a basic mathematical course of linear algebra. The course will covere the following subjects. (1)Vector spase (2)Linearly independence and linearly dependence of vector (3)Base of dimension of vector space (4)Linear mapping and simultaneous equations (5)Eigenvlue problem based on eigenvalue and eigenvector
books: Textbook:Linear algebra for engineering students {Morikita Publishing Co.Ltd.}
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of linear algebra Ⅰand Ⅱ. Enough skill of mathematics (vector,matrix,determinant,linear mapping, simultaneous equation)

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand concept of vector space and to perform the calculation of vector problems.
Be able to understand and describe linearly independence of vectors and to find base of vector space.
Be able to understand relationship between linear mapping and simultaneous equation and find a solution.
Be able to calculate eigenvalues and find eigenvectors.
